claim_scope: For each simple cyclic prism C_m square K_2 with m at least 3, except non-four-total-colorable m=5, the maximum discrepancy of four total color-class cardinalities is floor(m/3) minus the remainder of m modulo 3.
scientific_integrity: Complete combinatorial upper bound and explicitly compatible constructions supplied, with independently coded finite sanity checks; not externally validated.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only four-total colorings of simple cyclic prisms; it does not classify intermediate class vectors, or total colorings of arbitrary cubic graphs. Earlier work establishes existence, pasting constructions and the cubic color-class matching identity. The full 1988 original and full 2026 manuscript were inaccessible, so historical priority remains provisional.
title: Sharp color-class discrepancy in four-total colorings of cyclic prisms
